title: Set and Emit become a function and an event
rationale: The small backend emits an external function, a storage write, and Emitted.
logos_source:
Contract C
State
  record { x : Int = 0 }
Clauses
  Clause B(): Effect
    Provided That
      x == 0
    Shall
      All [ Set { field: "x", value: 1 }, Emit { event: "Ping", data: {} } ]
End

title: Transfer is an ERC-20 call
rationale: A Transfer effect moves tokens. An event-only note is not equivalent.
logos_source:
Contract C
  Parties
    client : Party = 0xC1e0000000000000000000000000000000000000
  State
    record { x : Int = 0 }
  Clauses
    Clause Pay(to: Address, amount: Int): Effect
      Provided That
        x == 0
      Shall
        Transfer { asset: 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48, from: client, to: to, amount: amount }
End

title: Invalid party address is a diagnostic
rationale: A non-hex party must not crash emit with FunctionClauseError.
logos_source:
Contract C
  Parties
    client : Party = 0xBu100000000000000000000000000000000000000
  State
    record { x : Int = 0 }
  Clauses
    Clause A(): Effect
      Provided That
        x == 0
      Shall
        Set { field: "x", value: 1 }
End

title: now and Duration lower to Solidity
rationale: now is block time and 7d is 604800. Pasting the tokens through is not valid Solidity.
logos_source:
Contract C
State
  record { start_ts : Int = 1700000000 }
Clauses
  Clause Release(): Effect
    Provided That
      now >= start_ts + Duration("7d")
    Shall
      Set { field: "start_ts", value: 1 }
End

title: Set and Emit execute on Anvil
rationale: The small Set/Emit contract is compiled with pinned solc and executed. Gas and bytecode layout are reported and are not required to match a reference.
logos_source:
Contract C
State
  record { x : Int = 0 }
Clauses
  Clause B(): Effect
    Provided That
      x == 0
    Shall
      All [ Set { field: "x", value: 1 }, Emit { event: "Ping", data: {} } ]
End
